script:
[Console]::OutputEncoding=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'
$profile=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'EasyCV-Acceptance-20261102-r3\chrome-store-profile'
if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $profile){throw 'Store Profile already exists; do not overwrite'}
$url='https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/bnbmgiidicjdbnmkmdnjeelhijnlhnjb'
$p=Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe' -ArgumentList ('--user-data-dir="'+$profile+'"'),'--remote-debugging-port=19333','--no-first-run','--no-default-browser-check','--new-window',$url -PassThru
@{browserPID=$p.Id;profile=$profile;port=19333;requestedURL=$url;extensionLoadFlagsUsed=$false;candidateInstalledInThisProfile=$false;purpose='Normal original CWS 1.1.1 installation and pre-upgrade nondefault baseline, not an upgrade';storeSubmission=$false}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress
